source: Durian Orchard (ការដាំធូរេន), by Vann Thana Busab and Montry Vong Phanith, published by the Northwest Cambodia Provinces Fruit Culture Development Committee (Battambang), 1998, 59pp, AIDOC code 178-001
text:
Once fruit has set and is developing, the source gives a two-stage fertilizer program.

Stage 1, about 5-6 weeks after fruit set: apply chemical fertilizer 12-12-17-2 or 13-13-21 or 4-16-24-24 at 2-4kg per tree, to support fruit filling.

Stage 2, about 7-8 weeks after fruit set: apply 0-0-50 (potassium-heavy) at 1-2kg per tree, to improve flesh quality and sweetness ahead of harvest.

If mulching with dried leaves during the fruiting period, avoid piling mulch directly against the trunk; instead mound it lightly around the drip-line, and time reapplication to every 1-2 weeks during active fruit growth. Watering during fruit development should be even and consistent -- sudden swings between drought and heavy watering during fruit filling are a common cause of husk cracking and fruit drop, so growers should aim for steady, moderate irrigation rather than infrequent heavy watering.
